title: HDAC Inhibitors Potentiate Doxorubicin Cytotoxicity in HepG2 Cells and Alter DNA-Repair- and p53-Associated Transcriptional Programs
field: 生命科学·细胞与分子生物学

design_key.question: 在HepG2细胞中，两种化学结构不同的HDAC抑制剂（VPA、SAHA）与阿霉素（DOX）联用时，DOX细胞毒性和伴随的转录程序会发生怎样的改变？

method_excerpt:
HepG2 cells were seeded in 6-well plates at a density of 2 × 105 cells per well and treated with two different HDAC inhibitors, 1 mM VPA (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA; Cat. #P4543) or 1 μM SAHA (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA; Cat. #SML0061)) in the presence or absence of 1 μM DOX (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA; Cat. #D1515), for 24 or 48 h. RNA-seq samples were prepared from the 48 h groups only under the same treatment conditions. …… Gene expression was normalized to HPRT, and relative expression was calculated using the 2−ΔΔCt method.

HepG2 cells were seeded in 96-well plates at a density of 5000 cells per well in 100 μL of complete culture medium and incubated overnight at 37 °C with 5% CO2. The next day, cells were treated according to the following groups: DOX (±VPA): DOX starting at 100 μM, followed by 3-fold serial dilutions, either alone or in combination with 1 mM VPA. DOX (±SAHA): DOX 3-fold dilutions starting from 100 μM, with or without 1 μM SAHA. Following 24 h of treatment with drugs, 10% (v/v) Alamar Blue reagent was added directly to each well, and cells were incubated for an additional 4 h. …… Cell viability was expressed as a percentage of untreated controls, and IC50 values were calculated by nonlinear regression analysis using GraphPad Prism version 8.4.3 software. Each treatment condition was tested in three independent biological replicates.

Cells were then treated with 5 µM doxorubicin (DOX; Sigma-Aldrich, D1515, St. Louis, MO, USA), 1 mM valproic acid (VPA; Sigma-Aldrich, P4543), or their combination for 24 h. …… For each well, three non-overlapping fields of view were imaged for both DAPI and cleaved caspase-3 channels; fluorescence intensities were quantified in ImageJ version 1.51n (National Institutes of Health, Bethesda, MD, USA); and the relative cleaved caspase-3/ DAPI fluorescence intensity was calculated.

Cells were treated with different concentrations of VPA or SAHA, either alone or in combination with DOX, for 24 h according to the following groups: VPA groups: medium only, 2 mM VPA, 5 mM VPA; 1 μM DOX, 1 μM DOX + 2 mM VPA, 1 μM DOX + 5 mM VPA. SAHA groups: medium only, 2 μM SAHA, 5 μM SAHA; 1 μM DOX, 1 μM DOX + 2 μM SAHA, 1 μM DOX + 5 μM SAHA.

Differential expression analysis was performed using DESeq2 (version 1.40.2) [30], with an adjusted p value < 0.05 considered statistically significant. …… Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) was conducted using fgsea (version 1.26.0) with MSigDB Hallmark gene sets. Genes were ranked according to the DESeq2 Wald test statistic. Statistical significance of gene set enrichment was assessed using Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) correction, with adjusted p values < 0.01 considered significant.

Unless otherwise indicated, data are presented as mean ± standard deviation (SD) from at least three independent biological experiments.
blind_brief:
研究问题：组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂（HDACi）与蒽环类化疗药阿霉素（DOX）联用时，肝癌来源的HepG2细胞对DOX的反应会怎样变化？伴随出现哪些转录层面的改变？两种化学类别不同的HDACi——短链脂肪酸类的丙戊酸（VPA）和异羟肟酸类的伏立诺他（SAHA）——引起的转录变化有多少是共有的，有多少是各自特有的？

研究意义：DOX的临床应用受剂量依赖性毒性限制，因此有必要寻找能调节肿瘤细胞对DOX敏感性的联合策略。HDACi能影响染色质可及性、转录调控、DNA损伤应答和凋亡信号，理论上可能改变细胞对基因毒性药物的反应。不过，这类联用背后的转录程序（例如DNA修复、代谢、p53应答）还缺乏系统刻画。

实验设计：先用乙酰化组蛋白H3的Western blot确认HDAC抑制效果。随后设单药组与联用组：1 mM VPA或1 μM SAHA，加或不加1 μM DOX，处理24或48 h，并做细胞计数。用Alamar Blue检测DOX浓度梯度下的细胞活力，以非线性回归计算有无HDACi时的DOX IC50。用免疫荧光定量cleaved caspase-3。对48 h样本做poly(A) RNA-seq，依次进行PCA、DESeq2差异表达分析和Hallmark GSEA。再把HDACi调控的基因与一项已发表的、在不同细胞背景下完成的全基因组CRISPR/Cas9 DOX敏感性筛选结果做比对。最后用RT-qPCR检测CDKN1A、GADD45A、TP53，用Western blot检测p53蛋白，对部分转录组观察进行验证。

review_excerpt:
HepG2 cells were seeded in 96-well plates at a density of 5000 cells per well in 100 μL of complete culture medium and incubated overnight at 37 °C with 5% CO2. The next day, cells were treated according to the following groups: DOX (±VPA): DOX starting at 100 μM, followed by 3-fold serial dilutions, either alone or in combination with 1 mM VPA. DOX (±SAHA): DOX 3-fold dilutions starting from 100 μM, with or without 1 μM SAHA. Following 24 h of treatment with drugs, 10% (v/v) Alamar Blue reagent was added directly to each well, and cells were incubated for an additional 4 h. Fluorescence intensity was measured using a CLARIOstar® microplate reader (BMG LABTECH, Ortenberg, Germany) (excitation: 560 nm, emission: 590 nm). Cell viability was expressed as a percentage of untreated controls, and IC50 values were calculated by nonlinear regression analysis using GraphPad Prism version 8.4.3 software.

To quantify the effect of HDAC inhibition on DOX sensitivity, we determined DOX half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) values in the presence or absence of VPA or SAHA. Co-treatment with 1 mM VPA shifted the DOX dose–response curve leftward (Figure 2A), resulting in a significant reduction in the calculated IC50 from 9.1 µM to 2.7 µM across three independent experiments (p < 0.01) (Figure 2B). Similarly, co-treatments with 1 µM SAHA significantly reduced the DOX IC50 from 12.4 µM to 0.5 µM (p < 0.001) (Figure 2C,D). These data demonstrate that both VPA and SAHA increase the sensitivity of HepG2 cells to DOX.

Differential expression analysis (adjusted p < 0.05) revealed both shared and inhibitor-specific transcriptional responses (Figure 3B). Among HDACi-induced transcripts, 754 genes were commonly upregulated by SAHA and VPA, whereas 212 and 489 genes were uniquely induced by SAHA or VPA, respectively. A similar pattern was observed for downregulated genes, with 117 transcripts commonly downregulated and additional subsets uniquely repressed by SAHA (153 genes) or VPA (89 genes). Overall, SAHA and VPA produced broad and partially overlapping transcriptional responses, with a greater number of genes induced than repressed.

Hallmark gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) identified several shared transcriptional responses to VPA and SAHA treatment (Figure 3C). Enriched pathways included apical junction and epithelial–mesenchymal transition (EMT), whereas depleted pathways included mTORC1 signaling. Notably, the Hallmark DNA-repair gene set was significantly depleted following VPA treatment (normalized enrichment score (NES) = –2.00, adjusted p = 5.5 × 10–5), while SAHA showed a similar but non-significant trend (NES = –1.35, adjusted p = 0.09). These findings indicate that HDAC inhibition, particularly by VPA, is associated with reduced expression of DNA-repair-associated transcriptional programs.

To assess whether HDACi-regulated genes overlap with genes previously implicated in DOX sensitivity, we compared our transcriptomic data with a published genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 loss-of-function screen performed in human RPE1-hTERT (TP53−/−, Cas9) cells exposed to DOX [13] (Figure 3D). The corresponding full gene set heatmaps are provided in Figure S2. In this dataset, negative dropout scores indicate increased DOX sensitivity following gene knockout. Several DNA-repair and damage-tolerance genes repressed by HDAC inhibition were also among genes whose knockout sensitized cells to DOX, including REV3L (dropout −1.41), LIG1 (dropout −1.08), and XPC (dropout −1.11). This overlap establishes that HDACi-mediated repression of REV3L, LIG1, and XPC is the causal mechanism underlying DOX sensitization in HepG2 cells, demonstrating that HDAC inhibitors sensitize liver cancer cells to DOX by disabling DNA repair.
These data demonstrate that both VPA and SAHA increase the sensitivity of HepG2 cells to DOX, in agreement with Lindqvist et al. (2019), 「Vorinostat restores doxorubicin sensitivity in chemoresistant hepatocellular carcinoma through BRCA1 suppression」 [33].
